Name: Bumblebee Tractor Sound Replacement
Author: lolakazam
Description:
[size=5]🐝 [font=Courier New]About this mod[/font][/size]
• Give your Bumblebee Tractor some proper bee sounds!
• This mod replaces the original tractor engine sounds with bee-inspired buzzing sounds, making your giant rideable bumblebee feel a little more at home in Stardew Valley.
• Created as a sound replacement patch for [b]Tractor Reskin - Bumblebee[/b], this little addition helps make the visual and audio experience match!

[size=5][font=Courier New]📋 Requirements[/font][/size]
Both of the following mods are required:
[quote]• [b]Tractor Mod[/b] – The original mod.
• [b]Tractor Reskin - Bumblebee[/b] – The bumblebee appearance reskin.[/quote][size=5][font=Courier New]📥 Installation[/font][/size]
[quote]1. Open the folder where you extracted my mod's downloaded files.
2. Locate the folder containing the replacement audio files.
3. Select and copy all the audio files included in this mod.
4. Now, locate the folder where your original [b]Tractor Mod[/b] is installed.
5. Inside the [b]Tractor Mod[/b] folder, navigate to the following directory: [b][i]Tractor Mod > assets > audio.[/i][/b]
6. Open the audio folder. You should find the original tractor sound files inside.
7. Paste my replacement audio files into this folder.
8. If your File manager asks whether you want to replace files with the same names, confirm the replacement by selecting "Replace the files in the destination" (or the equivalent option on your operating system).[/quote][u][b][i]IMPORTANT[/i][/b][/u]: [i]The replacement audio files must be placed inside the original Tractor Mod's [b]assets/audio[/b] folder, NOT inside the Bumblebee Reskin folder. You do not need to delete, modify, or reinstall either of the required mods. Simply replace the original audio files with the ones provided by me.[/i]

That's it! Your bumblebee is ready to buzz around the valley! 🐝
